title: Rosemary & Strawberry Scones
notes: This is a great recipe to experiment with flavours, try the flavour options listed or create your own keeping in mind the flavours will need to be balanced and too much liquid will effect the dough. Dried fruit, nuts and/or chocolate chips are a great start. If you would like to try a dairy version replace the coconut milk with buttermilk, leave out the vinegar and replace the vegan margarine with butter.

methodSections.heading: Rosemary & Strawberry Scones
steps: Mix the dry ingredients together in a mixing bowl.
Grate the frozen margarine and mix it into the dry ingredients.
Mix the wet ingredients together and then into the dry ingredients until everything combines into a dough.
Mix in the flavour ingredients or your choice.
Sprinkle a dry surface with a bit of rice flour and on this shape the dough into a circular shape roughly 2-3cm thick.
Brush with coconut milk and, if making sweet scones, sprinkle with some sugar.
Place on a baking tray and into the oven and bake for 15mins.
